name: Alyah
source:
[spoiler]Collared slave of Henri.[/spoiler] Former bandit, she run a scam on Julia's assistant(Nenha) and Solah, stealing from the orphanage. [spoiler]Due to a mishap during her collaring, Henri ended up as her Master, and forced her to work at the orphanage.[/spoiler]
